title: AutoFarm for Holiday and *asin Contructs EVENTs
features:
Autofarm Events:
  • Contracts (you can select the contract type from 1 to 6).
  • Holiday Hunt.
Autofarm Capability:
  • Simulation of the behavior of a real player.
  • Sending a chat message at the start of the game.
Macro:
  • Under development.

Misc:
  • Quickly open all current banners.
  • Automatic receipt of quests, battlepass, daily rewards.
  • Codes activation.
 Settings:
  • Enable/disable 3d Rendering.
  • Set FPS limit.
  • Discord and telegram webhooks.

Support for two languages: Russian and English (will be selected depending on your region).
